parameters.help: Show records using this field, e.g. `Name` or `Email`. The selected field cannot be an object, e.g. type `user`.
parameters.name: field
parameters.label: Display Field

parameters.help: For example `FIND('Jane', {Name})` or `{Name}>='Jane'`. You can find more information about the formula on [Airtable's website](https://support.airtable.com/hc/en-us/articles/203255215-Formula-Field-Reference).
parameters.name: formula
parameters.label: Formula

store.help: If an existing record ID is filled, the record will be updated with inserted data.
store.name: recordId
store.label: Record ID

help:
If smart links is enabled, you can a) use names in linked record fields instead of record IDs to select an existing record or create a new one if it doesn't exist b) use (add) new options in single/multiple select fields.
The Airtable API will perform best-effort automatic data conversion from string values. It is disabled by default to ensure data integrity, but it may be helpful for integrating with 3rd party data sources.
name: typecast
label: Smart links

help: Use column ID instead of column name for mapping. This enable persistency over column name change. Changing this value will break all existing mappings in this scenario.
name: useColumnId
label: Use Column ID
